name: MonarchAiGeneratedBadge
title: AiGeneratedBadge
wrapsNative: Text and a stroked Shape in a Capsule, with help(_:) for the pointer tooltip
summary: A small provenance badge that marks content as produced by AI, written with AI help, or edited by a person after AI wrote it, with the AI glyph.
whenToUse: Next to content that AI wrote or changed, so people can tell before they rely on it.
whenNotToUse: Not for a general status: use MonarchBadge. Not for how sure the model is, which is AiConfidenceMeter.
api: init(_ kind: MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeKind = .generated, model: String? = nil, date: Date? = nil, size: MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeSize = .md, isIconOnly: Bool = false, label: String? = nil, detail: String? = nil)
enum MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeKind { case generated, assisted, edited }

options.name: model
options.description: The model that produced the content. Part of the provenance line.

options.name: date
options.description: When the content was produced. Part of the provenance line, as a medium date and short time.

options.name: size
options.description: sm for table cells and dense lists, or md.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only the glyph. The label is still read by VoiceOver.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in label of the kind.

states.name: icon only
states.description: A round badge with the glyph alone.

appearance: A capsule in the subtle AI fill with the AI border and the strong AI role for the glyph and text, in every theme. The edited kind has a dashed border.
platformNotes: It is not built on MonarchBadge, because that has no AI tone, no custom glyph and no dashed border; it uses the badge's type and weight tokens so the two line up. The web shows the model and time in a tooltip on hover and focus. iOS shows no tooltip on touch, so they are the VoiceOver value and the system tooltip for a pointer (help), and must never be essential. The web's tooltip prop takes arbitrary content; detail is a String. Both sizes use the caption type role, because Monarch for iOS has no smaller one; sm has less padding and a smaller glyph. MonarchAiBotGlyph is the web's AiBotGlyph: SF Symbols has no robot, so the glyph is drawn from the same outline.
accessibility: One element whose label is the badge label and whose value is the provenance line.
The label is read for an icon-only badge too.
The edited kind differs by its dashed border and its text, not by colour.
The glyph is decorative inside the badge. MonarchAiBotGlyph on its own is hidden unless it is given a label.
Not interactive. The text and the glyph scale with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Without a model and a date there is no provenance line and no tooltip, except that an icon-only badge shows its label as the tooltip.
A long custom label wraps inside the capsule.
An empty model string counts as no model.
